logp.method_description: Oil (n–octanol)/water partition coefficient (Log Po/w) measurements. The examined complex was added to 6 mL of mixed solution (H2O/n-octanol (v/v=1 : 1)), and was sonicated in the dark for 30 min, then was centrifuged for 15 min. The absorbance of both the water and oil phases was measured. The oil/water partition coefficients were calculated based on Equation 1: Log P = log(Ao/Aw) where Ao and Aw represent the concentrations of the complexes in octanol and H2O, respectively. Each complex was measured three times to obtain the mean value.
